about.label: About the Foundation
about.heading: Skills that move careers forward
about.lead: AKGEC Skills Foundation (ASF) is an initiative of AKGEC supported by the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India, to promote industry-oriented skills among young students and professionals and make them employable.
about.description: ASF offers skill-development training through industry-institution collaboration, aligned with National Occupational Standards (NOS) and Qualification Packs (QP). Its facilities support training, prototyping, testing and measurement in automation, robotics and manufacturing.

training.label: Training & Programmes
training.heading: Build capability and make technology work
training.description: Learn by working with the tools, systems and standards used across modern industry, guided by experienced trainers and industry partners.

centres.label: Centres of Excellence
centres.heading: Where industry becomes hands-on
centres.description: Explore specialist labs and academies for robotics, welding, automation, manufacturing, metrology, pneumatics, digital fabrication and drone technology.

industry.label: Industry Engagement
industry.heading: Skills shaped around real challenges
industry.description: ASF connects practical training, prototyping, testing and measurement with the evolving needs of industry and society.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-KUKA Centre
trainingPrograms.text: Build practical robotics skills through programming and hands-on training with industrial robot applications.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-NI LabVIEW Academy
trainingPrograms.text: Explore LabVIEW, test and measurement, machine vision, control systems and industrial IoT.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-BOSCH CEAT
trainingPrograms.text: Develop hands-on technical skills through applied training at the AKGEC-BOSCH CEAT.

trainingPrograms.title: AIA-CIA
trainingPrograms.text: Learn integrated automation concepts and build practical, industry-oriented engineering skills.

trainingPrograms.title: AWTRC
trainingPrograms.text: Explore welding technology, thermal cutting and non-destructive testing through practical training.

trainingPrograms.title: AMC
trainingPrograms.text: Build advanced manufacturing skills with hands-on exposure to modern production technologies.

trainingPrograms.title: BOSCH JCC
trainingPrograms.text: Gain practical engineering experience through industry-oriented training at BOSCH JCC.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-FRONIUS
trainingPrograms.text: Develop welding skills with practical exposure to welding processes and related technologies.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-SIEMENS PLM
trainingPrograms.text: Explore product lifecycle management and digital engineering workflows used in industry.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-SIEMENS COE
trainingPrograms.text: Build applied technical skills through hands-on learning at the AKGEC-SIEMENS Centre of Excellence.

trainingPrograms.title: AKGEC-FABLAB
trainingPrograms.text: Turn ideas into prototypes with practical design, making and digital fabrication experiences.

trainingPrograms.title: CFC-AFIPD
trainingPrograms.text: Explore practical, career-focused technical training through the CFC-AFIPD programme.

industryFocusAreas.name: Automation
industryFocusAreas.details: Build practical skills with PLC, HMI and SCADA systems, industrial robotics, drives, hydraulics, pneumatics and mechatronics through ASF's specialist training centres.

industryFocusAreas.name: Aerospace & Defence
industryFocusAreas.details: AKGEC's IHFC collaboration with IIT Delhi supports future products in defence. ASF's DGCA-certified drone training, robotics and advanced-manufacturing facilities provide relevant hands-on engineering experience.

industryFocusAreas.name: Healthcare
industryFocusAreas.details: The AKGEC-IHFC collaboration identifies medical and healthcare product development as an area of work. ASF's prototyping, testing, robotics and automation capabilities can support engineering development in this field.

centresList.name: KUKA Industrial Robotics Training Centre
centresList.description: A robotics training centre established with KUKA Robotics for industrial robotics training, research, manufacturing and prototype services.
items: Robotic Arc Welding (MIG / CMT / Time Twin)
Robotic Spot Welding and Ultrasonic Welding
Robotic Milling and Robotic LASER Welding & Cutting
centresList.recognition: The brochure describes it as the first and largest robotics centre in the country and states that successful participants receive joint certification of AKGEC & KUKA.

centresList.name: FRONIUS Advance Welding Technology & Research Centre
centresList.description: A state-of-the-art centre jointly established by AKGEC and Fronius International for training, research and development in welding science, engineering and technology.
items: Short Term Training Program on Welding Technology
Competency Development Program for Arc Welders
ASNT Level-1 & 2 Certification Program (VT, PT, MT & UT)
centresList.recognition: The brochure describes it as the first state-of-the-art centre of its kind in Uttar Pradesh.

centresList.name: SIEMENS Advance Manufacturing Centre
centresList.description: A centre jointly established by AKGEC and Siemens at Ghaziabad to develop highly skilled technical manpower in advanced manufacturing.
items: CNC Operation & Programming - Turning / Milling / Grinding
Finishing School Program in Production Engineering
centresList.recognition: Hands-on learning uses NC production machines for turning, milling and grinding with Siemens CNC controllers and simulators.

centresList.name: NI LabVIEW Academy
centresList.description: An initiative of National Instruments under the Planet NI framework, focused on employability and innovative solutions in test, measurement and control. The brochure also designates it as a Centre of Excellence in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT).
centresList.recognition: The academy is described as a Centre of Excellence in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT).

centresList.name: BOSCH Rexroth Centre of Competence in Automation Technologies
centresList.description: A centre established with Bosch Rexroth AG, Germany, to bridge the technological gap and provide training and research for engineering and manufacturing industries.
centresList.recognition: The centre has six laboratories covering Hydraulics, Pneumatics, Sensorics, PLCs, Drives & Control and Mechatronics. Successful participants are awarded a joint certificate of AKGEC & BOSCH Rexroth.

centresList.name: AIA Centre for Integrated Automation
centresList.description: A centre jointly established by AKGEC and AIA to advance knowledge of automation applications through theoretical and practical exposure.
centresList.recognition: The brochure describes world-class training infrastructure and working models based on innovative industrial applications.

centresList.name: SIEMENS PLM Centre of Excellence
centresList.description: A Siemens PLM centre using software for product lifecycle management and manufacturing operations management, including product design, analysis, manufacturing and simulation.
centresList.recognition: The brochure lists Siemens software including FEMAP, JACK, NX, ROBCAD, SOLIDEDGE, PLANT SIMULATION and PROCESS SIMULATE.

centresList.name: MITSUBISHI Authorised Training Centre
centresList.description: An authorised factory-automation training centre at AKGEC, established by Mitsubishi Electric India Pvt. Ltd. to bridge the technological gap and support applied research.
centresList.recognition: The centre provides access to modular and micro controllers, inverters, servos and HMIs for high-end factory automation applications.

centresList.name: FAB LAB Centre of Digital Manufacturing
centresList.description: A technical prototyping platform for innovation and invention, providing a small-scale digital fabrication workshop for learning, experimentation and creation of smart devices.
centresList.recognition: The brochure describes the Fab Lab as a platform connecting learners, educators, technologists, researchers and innovators with a global knowledge-sharing network.

centresList.name: BOSCH Joint Certification Centre
centresList.description: A joint certification centre established by AKGEC and Bosch Ltd. for automotive training with a balance of theory and practical learning.
centresList.recognition: The centre offers essential, intermediate and advanced levels and hands-on training for engineers, technicians and mechanics.

centresList.name: ZEISS Calibration & Testing Centre
centresList.description: An NABL-accredited facility established with ZEISS to meet dimensional metrology requirements of industry.
centresList.recognition: The brochure states that the facility provides NABL-accredited calibration services, reverse engineering services and dimensional testing services and complies with IS/ISO/IEC 17025:2017.

centresList.name: JANATICS Industrial Pneumatic Knowledge Centre
centresList.description: An Industrial Pneumatic Knowledge Centre jointly established by AKGEC and Janatics India Pvt. Ltd. to develop skilled manpower in industrial pneumatics and support low-cost automation solutions for SMEs.
items: Certificate Program in Flexible Manufacturing System
centresList.recognition: The brochure describes it as India's first Industrial Pneumatic Knowledge Centre and states that it also functions as an NSIC Training-cum-Incubation Centre.

centresList.name: SIEMENS Centre of Excellence in Automation
centresList.description: Established in 2016 at AKGEC, Ghaziabad, this centre was developed with Siemens to bridge the gap between academia and industry through hands-on training and applied research.
items: Industrial AC & DC Drives - Basic / Advance
centresList.recognition: The brochure describes four specialized laboratories equipped with PLCs, DCS, SCADA, HMI, drives and instrumentation systems.

centresList.name: DGCA Certified Remote Pilot Training Drone Academy
centresList.description: AKGEC Drone Academy is an initiative of ASF and a DGCA-Certified Remote Pilot Training Organization focused on drone technology education and training.
centresList.recognition: DGCA-Certified Remote Pilot Training Organization (RPTO), Authorization No. 35/2024. The brochure lists a smartboard classroom, drone simulation lab, drone flying station and four DGCA type-certified drones.

centresList.name: Common Facility Center (CFC)
centresList.partner: AKG Foundation for Innovation and Product Development
centresList.description: A Common Facility Center proposed at AKGEC, Ghaziabad, under Uttar Pradesh's One District, One Product (ODOP) scheme. It aims to support local general engineering industries through advanced manufacturing, material testing, research and product development.
centresList.recognition: An initiative to support Ghaziabad's general engineering industry and promote industry-academia collaboration.
